descriptionChirho: The proper noun Aram, referring either to the person (son of Shem, Gen 10:22) or the geographic region of Aram (Syria/Mesopotamia). All three sense clusters represent identical referents differing only by prepositional framing: bare nominative (eng: Aram, spa: Aram, arb: أَرَامَ, kor: 아람, swa: Aramu), locative with bet/against (eng: in-Aram, spa: en-Aram, arb: في-أَرامَ, swa: katika-Aramu), and directional with min/lamed (eng: from-Aram, spa: de-Aram, arb: مِن-أَرامَ, swa: kutoka-Aramu). The multilingual signatures are uniform across all clusters, confirming a single proper-noun sense.
